methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: VSU receives $1 million for new AI and cybersecurity center
signals.signal_reading: VSU's $1M AI center investment in historically underserved Southside signals institutional capacity-building, but the concentration of funding in a single university hub rather than distributed community programs suggests deep capability will remain geographically isolated.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA to boost community AI education indicates a deliberate strategy for distributed skill-building beyond elite institutions, potentially creating peer learning networks that spread deep capability through Richmond's broader workforce.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Young Richmond workers feeling AI pressure without accompanying deep capability development suggests shallow platform adoption is creating workforce anxiety rather than empowerment, signaling neither depth nor meaningful distribution is materializing.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: On-demand workforce training through platform provider ed2go suggests broad but shallow AI adoption in underserved regions—accessible tools without deep technical capability development, fitting the 'software does it for you' model for areas beyond metro hubs.

signals.title: TurbineOne Establishes Virginia Headquarters, Launches T1 Edgeworks Innovation Center - The AI Journal
signals.signal_reading: TurbineOne's innovation center establishment in NoVA reinforces the region's gravitational pull for AI infrastructure and R&D investment, deepening the concentration of advanced capability in the state's already-dominant tech corridor.
